posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
k1tac said:
on the second monitor,
Click to expand...
unfortunately the editor cannot handle the second monitor, it only works on the primary monitor.
It is one of the lesser known quirks of the program.
you'll need to move the program back to the primary monitor.
if you can't do that one of the regular ways, shutdown, temporarily disconnect the second monitor, launch the editor (without a second monitor it is forced back to the first), move the editor a bit to register the new position and shutdown again to reconnect the second monitor
